note: Options+equities automation run (routine-triggered, prompt v8). This run owns the heartbeat, the market_brief rebuild, the reset of the daily realized-loss cap and BOTH entry throttles, and the first live position management since Wednesday. NVDA gapped +6.79% to 223.898; SMH +2.53%, TSM +1.40%, AVGO +2.06%. RECONCILIATION, ZERO DRIFT BOTH BOOKS: get_option_positions(nonzero) returns exactly ONE contract -- SPY 2026-11-20 700P qty 1.0000 @ 749.00 (agentic, insurance-exempt hedge) -- all six pending_* fields 0.0000. get_equity_positions returns exactly ONE position -- PNC 1.825758 sh @ 246.47, shares_available_for_sells 1.825758, all hold buckets 0.000000. Both match holdings.json one-for-one. Lot invariant asserted in code: 1 x 7.49 x 100 == 749.00 == max_loss. CAPITAL: get_portfolio total $4,008.35 = equity $440.09 / options $561.00 / cash $3,007.26. unleveraged_buying_power $3,007.26 EQUALS buying_power, so no margin is extended (FOUR LAWS #4 satisfied); less the $250 reserve, deployable across both books is $2,757.26. Realized options P/L reset to $0.00 vs the -$400 cap; options throttle 0 of 8, equity throttle 0 of 3. Open: 1 exempt hedge only -- all five agentic option slots free. NOTHING TRADED, and that is the measured answer on four independent grounds, none of them inactivity. (a) EQUITY BOOK IS GATED SHUT: the newest committed report is 2026-08-26 (morning 14:02Z / intraday 19:01Z); the 2026-08-27 GitHub Actions report had not landed by 13:35Z. Prompt v8 THE EQUITY BOOK: a stale report = no autonomous equity trades this run. That is a gate, not a judgment. (b) NVDA CORE FAILS THE TREND-MATURITY GATE ON ALL THREE LIMBS: the move has already run (+6.79% gap landing at 223.898, which is INSIDE the month-long 208-228 range and 4.02 BELOW the 2026-08-17 high of 227.92 -- the gap returned NVDA to the range top, it did not break it); the catalyst is priced (a 6.79% gap IS the market pricing the beat); and the present tape DIVERGES rather than confirms -- AMD -1.34%, MSFT -1.10%, XLF -0.74%, and QQQ faded from 718.15 at the auction to 716.03 within three minutes. (c) THE IV CRUSH WAS REAL BUT DID NOT CREATE CHEAP PREMIUM -- measured, not assumed. NVDA ATM IV on the 2026-09-25 board (29 DTE) is 0.341758, down 7.26 vol points (-17.5%) from 0.4144 yesterday, exactly the mechanical post-event crush. But against realized it reads iv_rv 0.9457 raw and 1.0710 EX-GAP, and the ex-gap figure is the governing one because the 09-25 board expires long before the 2026-11-18 print. Fair-to-slightly-rich, not a bargain. Both index names also fail ex-gap IV sanity: SPY 1.2002, QQQ 1.1049. (d) TACTICAL HAD NO MEASURABLE TRIGGER: the run fired at 13:30Z and quotes were re-taken past the auction, but only a handful of 5-minute bars existed, so the trailing-30-to-60-minute volume baseline the confirmation clause requires does not yet exist, and the 2026-08-26T14:31Z finding says fresh bars are provisional until a second read agrees. QQQ opened above both its 20-day (714.6420) and 50-day (712.3606) for the first time in days and immediately faded 2.12 points -- a fading gap is not a level breaking.
